description: Build a printable set from exactly nine public image URLs, in grid order (left to right, top to bottom). Returns thumbnail previews, the price, and a set_hash to pass to place_order. Images must be JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB each, reachable over plain https with no redirect. Private or internal addresses are refused. Nothing is charged and no order is created.

images.description: Exactly nine image URLs in grid order.

items.description: Public https URL to a JPEG or PNG.
